notes.source: Vampire: The Requiem 2e (Onyx Path). See books/vtr.txt and docs/vampire-overlay-spec.md.
notes.chargen: 3 Discipline dots (≥2 in-clan); 10 Merit dots; Blood Potency 1; Humanity 7; Mask+Dirge; Mask and Dirge Touchstones; optional bloodline.

clans.name: Daeva
clans.bane: The Wanton Curse — cannot spend Willpower to resist a temptation tied to Mask/Dirge vice; obsessive desire.
clans.description: Serpents. Hedonist seducers whose hungers are as alluring as they are fatal.

clans.name: Gangrel
clans.bane: The Savage Curse — lose 1 die from Mental and Social pools while frenzying or failing to resist frenzy.
clans.description: Savages. Half-beast nomads who walk the line between predator and animal.

clans.name: Mekhet
clans.bane: The Shadow Curse — one extra aggravated from sunlight and fire; senses that hunt them gain +2.
clans.description: Shadows. Scholar-spies of the dead, custodians of forbidden lore.

clans.name: Nosferatu
clans.bane: The Lonely Curse — presence inflicts Bestial; no 10-again on Social rolls to put others at ease.
clans.description: Haunts. Monstrous outsiders who weaponize fear and isolation.

clans.name: Ventrue
clans.bane: The Tyrant's Curse — each story, a new persistent Condition reflecting cracks from power and control.
clans.description: Lords. Aristocratic rulers whose grip on power slowly poisons the mind.

covenants.name: Carthian Movement
covenants.description: Revolutionary modernists fusing mortal politics with the Requiem. Domain laws that reward compliance.

covenants.name: Circle of the Crone
covenants.description: Pagan mystery cult embracing the curse as sacred. Blood sorcery rituals (Crúac).

covenants.name: Invictus
covenants.description: The First Estate. Feudal aristocracy of oaths, tradition, and pyramid politics.

covenants.name: Lancea et Sanctum
covenants.description: Damned church teaching vampires as God's dark angels. Divine blood miracles (Theban Sorcery).

covenants.name: Ordo Dracul
covenants.description: Esoteric order seeking to transcend the curse through Coils and Scales of the Dragon.

covenants.name: Unaligned
covenants.description: No covenant. Free of formal oaths and support — and of covenant politics.

disciplines.name: Animalism
disciplines.summary: Command and commune with animals and the Beast.

disciplines.name: Auspex
disciplines.summary: Heightened senses, aura sight, and psychic perception.

maskDirgeArchetypes.name: Authoritarian
maskDirgeArchetypes.description: Must be on top; asserts control and dominance.

maskDirgeArchetypes.name: Child
maskDirgeArchetypes.description: Looks for caretakers; diffuses responsibility.

maskDirgeArchetypes.name: Competitor
maskDirgeArchetypes.description: Tests herself against others in all things.

maskDirgeArchetypes.name: Conformist
maskDirgeArchetypes.description: Needs external structure and hierarchy.

maskDirgeArchetypes.name: Conspirator
maskDirgeArchetypes.description: Layers machination into every task.

maskDirgeArchetypes.name: Courtesan
maskDirgeArchetypes.description: Exists so others may enjoy themselves.

maskDirgeArchetypes.name: Cult Leader
maskDirgeArchetypes.description: Wants faith and devotion directed at her word.

maskDirgeArchetypes.name: Deviant
maskDirgeArchetypes.description: Flouts norms; crime, sin, and debauchery.

maskDirgeArchetypes.name: Follower
maskDirgeArchetypes.description: Needs direction; finds the right person to obey.

maskDirgeArchetypes.name: Guru
maskDirgeArchetypes.description: Repository of wisdom; teaches and advises.

maskDirgeArchetypes.name: Idealist
maskDirgeArchetypes.description: Never accepts compromise of the vision.

maskDirgeArchetypes.name: Jester
maskDirgeArchetypes.description: Truth through humor and mockery.

maskDirgeArchetypes.name: Junkie
maskDirgeArchetypes.description: Indulgence before anything else.

maskDirgeArchetypes.name: Martyr
maskDirgeArchetypes.description: Puts others and the cause before self.

maskDirgeArchetypes.name: Masochist
maskDirgeArchetypes.description: Savors suffering; never runs from pain.

maskDirgeArchetypes.name: Monster
maskDirgeArchetypes.description: Embraces the Beast without apology.

maskDirgeArchetypes.name: Nomad
maskDirgeArchetypes.description: Never stays; freedom is the only law.

maskDirgeArchetypes.name: Nurturer
maskDirgeArchetypes.description: Protects and grows others.

maskDirgeArchetypes.name: Perfectionist
maskDirgeArchetypes.description: Nothing less than flawless will do.

maskDirgeArchetypes.name: Penitent
maskDirgeArchetypes.description: Seeks atonement for sins of the Blood.

maskDirgeArchetypes.name: Questioner
maskDirgeArchetypes.description: Accepts nothing at face value.

maskDirgeArchetypes.name: Rebel
maskDirgeArchetypes.description: Opposes authority on principle.

maskDirgeArchetypes.name: Scholar
maskDirgeArchetypes.description: Knowledge is the only lasting power.

maskDirgeArchetypes.name: Social Chameleon
maskDirgeArchetypes.description: Becomes whatever the room needs.

maskDirgeArchetypes.name: Spy
maskDirgeArchetypes.description: Secrets are currency; observation is survival.

maskDirgeArchetypes.name: Survivor
maskDirgeArchetypes.description: Own existence above all things.

maskDirgeArchetypes.name: Visionary
maskDirgeArchetypes.description: The future she sees is the only map.
